take: Per the team's announcement, Tampa Bay recalled F Sam O'Reilly from Syracuse (AHL) and placed F Brayden Point on injured reserve. Point has 16 points in 17 games, and TBL controls more of the chances when he plays (about 6 points better in share of expected goals, the quality of shots taken versus allowed). Going by how the coach has used his players, Brandon Hagel (19:30 a night) is next in line for Point's minutes, and Anthony Cirelli is the likeliest to move up. We have no numbers on O'Reilly.
